mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS "storeId", s.code AS "code", s.name AS "name", s.platform AS "platform", s.marketplace AS "marketplace", s.currency AS "currency", s.owner_id AS "ownerId", u.nickname AS "ownerName", s.status AS "status" FROM ecom_store s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.owner_id ORDER BY s.id
SELECT u.id AS "userId", u.nickname AS "nickname" FROM sys_user u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_store s WHERE s.owner_id = u.id) ORDER BY u.id

SELECT o.store_id AS "storeId", COUNT(*) AS "orders", COALESCE(SUM(o.total_base), 0) AS "sales", COALESCE(SUM(o.profit), 0) AS "profit" FROM ecom_order o WHERE o.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND o.order_time >= #{begin} AND o.order_time < #{end} GROUP BY o.store_id

SELECT d.store_id AS "storeId", COALESCE(SUM(d.spend), 0) AS "spend", COALESCE(SUM(d.ad_sales), 0) AS "adSales" FROM ecom_ad_daily d WHERE d.ad_date >= #{begin} AND d.ad_date <= #{end} GROUP BY d.store_id
SELECT r.store_id AS "storeId", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM ecom_return r WHERE r.status <> 'CLOSED' AND r.create_time >= #{begin} AND r.create_time < #{end} GROUP BY r.store_id
SELECT v.store_id AS "storeId", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM ecom_review v WHERE v.rating <= #{maxRating} AND v.review_date >= #{begin} AND v.review_date <= #{end} GROUP BY v.store_id

SELECT oi.seller_sku AS "sellerSku", MAX(oi.platform_item_id) AS "platformItemId", MAX(oi.title) AS "title", SUM(oi.qty) AS "qty" FROM ecom_order_item oi JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId} AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND o.order_time >= #{begin} AND o.order_time < #{end} GROUP BY oi.seller_sku ORDER BY SUM(oi.qty) DESC, oi.seller_sku LIMIT #{limit}
